item.text: [{"task_id":"45bbe264","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    crossing = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    seeds = np.argwhere(grid != background)","    out = np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    for row, col in seeds:","        out[:, col] = grid[row, col]","    for row, col in seeds:","        out[row, :] = grid[row, col]","    for row, col in seeds:","        for other_row, other_col in seeds:","            if row != other_row or col != other_col:","                out[row, other_col] = crossing","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[2]},"params":{"colors":[0,2]},"rationale":"Extend each nonbackground seed across its entire row and column in its original color.
